name: Annie's Dineinn
storyline:
The year is 2002. After struggling to find regular jobs as a tradie, putting food on the table was getting harder and harder as your daughter is growing up. You see a business opportunity and take a loan to buy a motel in the middle of nowhere in Tasmania. You move out of the shoebox apartment in Melbourne, Australia and head over to Tasmania.
You arrive at the motel with your daughter and settle in. The locals come to meet and greet with you. While some are happy to have you and some act suspicious. Have conversations with people how you like, but remember this, CHOICES MATTER and your actions may have consequences later. You are a father and decisions may also impact your daughter, so choose wisely.
Cook food to orders, rent the motel rooms, and take care of customers while maintaining

The horror twist:
Maintain your sanity or you will start seeing things. Seeing weird things happen more common when your sanity is low. And if you die, you lose the day’s progress. If you make enemies with the locals, be careful to lock all doors at night. There are things in the attic and the basement that cannot be explained. Try to keep your curious daughter from going in there.

In Short:
There will be some difficult times and tough choices. Are you ready you take up the challenge to restore the building and do a grand opening? Or will you chicken out and run away if things get tough.
summary:
DineInn is a cooking game where you manage a kitchen and motel while maintaining a relationship with your daughter and the local communities.
Your choices and decisions show impact in the real world. Work hard through the tough times and restore the building for a grand opening.

The gameplay can be described as a combination of elements from farming, poultry, cooking, cleaning, inventory management, restoration,etc together to make a fun gameplay.
